question: The average age of 39 students of a class is 39 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 40 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By net deviation method: Value of new member = Old Average + (Total new members × Increase in average)

⇒ Total members including teacher = 39 + 1 = 40

⇒ Increase in average = 40 − 39 = 1 year

⇒ Age of teacher = 39 + (40 × 1) = 79

**∴ The correct answer is 79 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 39 students = 39 years.

Average age of (39 students + 1 teacher) = 40 years.
